plan.title: Psoriasis lesional vs control hallmark GSEA
plan.analytical_narrative:
The research question asks only which hallmark pathways change between treated (psoriasis lesional) and control skin. The differential expression is already delivered as /data/inputs/results/de_results.csv (12,000 genes x 8 columns, DESeq2 treated vs control contrast), so no new gene-level test is fitted and no unasked DE scope is added. The plan therefore has three steps.

T1S1 is a sample-structure sanity check on the delivered raw Salmon counts (counts.csv, 12,000 genes x 12 samples, gene symbols in the first column) with metadata.csv (12 rows, condition). This exists because the data profile flags sample_01 with a library size about 4x below the median: blind VST, PCA on the top 500 variable genes, a sample-distance heatmap, and library size / detected-gene counts per sample tell us whether that sample distorts the group structure that produced the delivered contrast. Per R-0008 the sample is kept and reported, not silently dropped — the delivered results table was computed with all 12 samples and nothing in this plan re-fits it, so this step is diagnostic context for interpreting the enrichment, not a filter.

T2S1 is the answer to the question: fgsea preranked GSEA of every tested gene in de_results.csv against the MSigDB human hallmark collection (50 sets, 2026.1 release, staged in the reference store). Ranking metric is the DESeq2 Wald statistic (the stat column) — that is the disputed choice of R-0108 and it is stated here explicitly: the Wald statistic is signed and scaled by its own standard error, so it does not give a large rank to a noisy low-count gene the way an unshrunken log2FC does, and it does not saturate into ties the way a signed p-value does. The full ranked list is used, never a thresholded one. Sets are intersected with the tested genes and kept at 15-500 members; BH adjustment across the 50 sets; redundant leading-edge-overlapping sets are collapsed before reporting. Gene symbols are the identifier space of both the results table and the hallmark GMT, so a symbol-space match is direct, and the unmatched share is reported.

T1S3 assembles the report: the significant hallmark sets with NES, padj, set size and leading-edge genes with their gene-level statistics, the leading-edge overlap between reported sets, the pinned collection name and release, the rank metric, the universe, the size window, the tie rule, the seed, and sessionInfo. It states the direction convention of the delivered contrast (positive log2FC = higher in treated/lesional) because every NES sign depends on it, and it carries the caveat that enrichment results are method-dependent and each hallmark hit is a hypothesis.

What this plan does not do: it does not re-run differential expression, it does not run an over-representation test (R-0103 — a hypergeometric test on a thresholded list is the wrong instrument when the ranked list is available), and it does not add Reactome/GO/WikiPathways passes, because the question named hallmark pathways specifically. Those collections are staged and remain available as a follow-up if the hallmark result needs resolving to specific pathways.

fgsea preranked GSEA on the DESeq2 Wald statistic with MSigDB Hallmark human 2026.1
Enrichment report with leading edge, collection version, rank metric, universe, size window, and reproducibility record
